blocks.en: Analytic Semigroups and Their Generators

blocks.label: subsec:analytic-semigroups-generators

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We shall now discuss a class of semigroups which in many respects allows for much stronger results than strongly continuous semigroups. In particular we shall obtain:\begin{enumerate}\item Better regularity of solutions to initial-value problems.\item Better results concerning perturbations of the infinitesimal generator.\item A relationship between the type of the semigroup and the spectrum of the infinitesimal generator.\end{enumerate}We begin with the definition of an analytic semigroup.
blocks.zh: 现在讨论一类半群, 它在许多方面可得到比强连续半群强得多的结果. 特别地, 将得到:\begin{enumerate}\item 初值问题的解具有更好的正则性.\item 关于无穷小生成元扰动的更好结果.\item 半群的型与无穷小生成元的谱之间的关系.\end{enumerate}先给出解析半群的定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A strongly continuous semigroup $\exp(At)$ is called an \textbf{analytic semigroup} if the following conditions hold:\begin{enumerate}\item For some $\theta\in(0,\pi/2)$, $\exp(At)\in\mathcal{L}(X)$ can be extended to $t\in\Delta_\theta=\{0\}\cup\{t\in\mathbb{C}\mid|\arg t|<\theta\}$ and the conditions of Definition~\ref{def:strongly-continuous-semigroup} hold for $t\in\Delta_\theta$.\item For $t\in\Delta_\theta\setminus\{0\}$, $\exp(At)$ is analytic in $t$ (in the sense of the uniform operator topology).\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 若强连续半群 $\exp(At)$ 满足以下条件, 则称其为\textbf{解析半群}:\begin{enumerate}\item 对某个 $\theta\in(0,\pi/2)$, $\exp(At)\in\mathcal{L}(X)$ 可延拓到 $t\in\Delta_\theta=\{0\}\cup\{t\in\mathbb{C}\mid|\arg t|<\theta\}$, 且 Definition~\ref{def:strongly-continuous-semigroup} 的条件对 $t\in\Delta_\theta$ 成立.\item 对 $t\in\Delta_\theta\setminus\{0\}$, $\exp(At)$ 关于 $t$ 解析 (按一致算子拓扑的意义).\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: def:analytic-semigroup

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The most important question now is how to characterize the infinitesimal generators of analytic semigroups. This is addressed by the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 现在最重要的问题是如何刻画解析半群的无穷小生成元. 下面的定理处理这一问题.

blocks.en:
We next show that \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} does indeed represent an analytic semigroup generated by $A$. Clearly, \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} is defined for $|\arg t|<\phi-\frac{\pi}{2}$ and it is analytic in $t$. We next check the semigroup property. We denote by $T(t)$ the right-hand side of \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} and we take $\Gamma^{\prime}$ to be a path with the same properties as $\Gamma$, but lying entirely to the right of $\Gamma$. Then we have\[\begin{aligned}
T(s)T(t)&=\left(\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\right)^2\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda^{\prime}s+\lambda t}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\\
&=\left(\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\right)^2\Bigg[\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\\
&\qquad-\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\Bigg]\\
&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda(t+s)}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda=T(t+s).
\end{aligned}\]Here we have used the identity $(\lambda I-A)^{-1}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}=(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}[(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}-(\lambda I-A)^{-1}]$ and the fact that\[\begin{aligned}
\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda&=0,\\
\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}&=-2\pi i e^{\lambda s}.
\end{aligned}\]
blocks.zh:
接下来证明 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} 确实表示由 $A$ 生成的解析半群. 显然, \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} 对 $|\arg t|<\phi-\frac{\pi}{2}$ 有定义, 且关于 $t$ 解析. 再验证半群性质. 用 $T(t)$ 表示 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} 的右端, 取 $\Gamma^{\prime}$ 为具有与 $\Gamma$ 相同性质但完全位于 $\Gamma$ 右侧的路径. 则有\[\begin{aligned}
T(s)T(t)&=\left(\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\right)^2\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda^{\prime}s+\lambda t}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\\
&=\left(\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\right)^2\Bigg[\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\\
&\qquad-\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\Bigg]\\
&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda(t+s)}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda=T(t+s).
\end{aligned}\]这里使用了恒等式 $(\lambda I-A)^{-1}(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}=(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}[(\lambda^{\prime}I-A)^{-1}-(\lambda I-A)^{-1}]$ 以及事实\[\begin{aligned}
\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda&=0,\\
\int_{\Gamma^{\prime}}e^{\lambda^{\prime}s}(\lambda-\lambda^{\prime})^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda^{\prime}&=-2\pi i e^{\lambda s}.
\end{aligned}\]

blocks.en:
For $t\neq0$, we find from \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation}:\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}T(t)&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma\lambda e^{\lambda t}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}A(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda+\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}I\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&=AT(t).
\end{aligned}\]Here the closedness of $A$ is used to justify taking it outside the integral. Hence we have\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{T(h)-I}{h}u&=\lim_{\epsilon\to0}\dfrac{T(h)-T(\epsilon)}{h}u\\
&=\lim_{\epsilon\to0}\dfrac{1}{h}\int_\epsilon^h AT(t)u\,\mathrm{d}t=\dfrac{1}{h}\int_0^h T(t)Au
\end{aligned}\]for $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$. As $h\to0$, we obtain $Au$ in the limit; hence the infinitesimal generator of the semigroup is an extension of $A$. Since $A$ has a resolvent in the half-plane $\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega$, this extension cannot be proper.
blocks.zh:
对 $t\neq0$, 由 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} 得到:\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}T(t)&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma\lambda e^{\lambda t}(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&=\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}A(\lambda I-A)^{-1}\,\mathrm{d}\lambda+\dfrac{1}{2\pi i}\int_\Gamma e^{\lambda t}I\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&=AT(t).
\end{aligned}\]这里利用 $A$ 的闭性来说明可将其提出积分号. 因而对 $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$ 有\[\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{T(h)-I}{h}u&=\lim_{\epsilon\to0}\dfrac{T(h)-T(\epsilon)}{h}u\\
&=\lim_{\epsilon\to0}\dfrac{1}{h}\int_\epsilon^h AT(t)u\,\mathrm{d}t=\dfrac{1}{h}\int_0^h T(t)Au
\end{aligned}\]当 $h\to0$ 时, 极限为 $Au$; 因而该半群的无穷小生成元是 $A$ 的延拓. 由于 $A$ 在半平面 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda>\omega$ 中有预解算子, 这一延拓不可能是真延拓.

blocks.en: In the course of the proof above, we proved that $\exp(At)$ is differentiable for $t>0$ and that $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\exp(At)=A\exp(At)$. Using in essence the same argument, we can show that $\exp(At)$ is actually infinitely often differentiable and $\frac{\mathrm{d}^n}{\mathrm{d}t^n}\exp(At)=A^n\exp(At)$. In particular, this implies that the range of $\exp(At)$ is contained in $\mathcal{D}(A^n)$ for every $n$. In PDE applications, this usually translates into a smoothing property. Even if the initial conditions have singularities, the solution is smooth (of class $C^\infty$) for positive $t$. For future use, we note the following bound on the norm of $A\exp(At)$.
blocks.zh: 在上述证明中, 已证明 $\exp(At)$ 对 $t>0$ 可微, 且 $\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\exp(At)=A\exp(At)$. 采用本质上相同的论证, 可证明 $\exp(At)$ 实际上无穷次可微, 且 $\frac{\mathrm{d}^n}{\mathrm{d}t^n}\exp(At)=A^n\exp(At)$. 特别地, 这意味着对每个 $n$, $\exp(At)$ 的值域都包含于 $\mathcal{D}(A^n)$. 在 PDE 应用中, 这通常转化为光滑化性质. 即使初始条件具有奇性, 解对正的 $t$ 也是光滑的 (为 $C^\infty$ 类). 为以后使用, 记录下面对 $A\exp(At)$ 的范数的界.

blocks.en: In ODE courses we learn that the zero solution of the equation $\dot u=Au$ is stable if all eigenvalues of $A$ have negative real parts. Indeed, this is the most widely applied practical criterion for evaluating stability. Naturally, one would like to apply the same type of criterion for physical systems described by PDEs. This raises the following question: If $A$ is the generator of a semigroup and the spectrum of $A$ is entirely in the left half-plane at a positive distance from the imaginary axis, does it follow that $\|\exp(At)\|$ is bounded as $t\to\infty$? Or equivalently, is there a connection between an upper bound on the real part of the spectrum of $A$ and the type of the semigroup? Unfortunately, in the general context of $C_0$-semigroups, the answer is negative. Although the counterexamples are not the kind that would arise ``naturally\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ in physical applications, no practical conditions are known that would lead to a positive result. The state of current knowledge is clearly unsatisfactory. For analytic semigroups, however, the problem is quite easy. We have the following result.
blocks.zh: 在 ODE 课程中学到, 若 $A$ 的所有特征值都具有负实部, 则方程 $\dot u=Au$ 的零解稳定. 实际上, 这是评估稳定性时应用最广泛的实用判据. 自然希望将同类判据用于 PDE 所描述的物理系统. 这提出以下问题: 若 $A$ 为某半群的生成元, 且 $A$ 的谱完全位于左半平面并与虚轴保持正距离, 是否可推出 $\|\exp(At)\|$ 在 $t\to\infty$ 时有界? 或等价地, $A$ 的谱的实部的上界与半群的型之间是否存在联系? 遗憾的是, 在一般 $C_0$ 半群的情形下, 答案是否定的. 虽然反例并非物理应用中会 ``自然\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 出现的那一类, 但尚无已知的实用条件可得到肯定结果. 目前的认识状况显然并不令人满意. 然而, 对解析半群, 这一问题很容易. 有以下结果.

blocks.en: Let $A$ be the infinitesimal generator of an analytic semigroup and assume that the spectrum of $A$ is entirely to the left of the line $\operatorname{Re}\lambda=\omega$. Then there exists a constant $M$ such that $\|\exp(At)\|\leq M\exp(\omega t)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为解析半群的无穷小生成元, 并假设 $A$ 的谱完全位于直线 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda=\omega$ 的左侧. 则存在常数 $M$, 使 $\|\exp(At)\|\leq M\exp(\omega t)$.
blocks.label: thm:analytic-semigroup-spectrum-controls-growth

blocks.en: The idea of the proof is to shift the contour in \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} so that it lies entirely to the left of $\operatorname{Re}\lambda=\omega$. We leave the details of the argument as an exercise (Problem~\ref{ex:analytic-semigroup-spectral-growth-proof}).
blocks.zh: 证明的思路是移动 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-contour-integral-representation} 中的积分路径, 使其完全位于 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda=\omega$ 的左侧. 将论证细节留作习题 (Problem~\ref{ex:analytic-semigroup-spectral-growth-proof}).

blocks.en: Fractional Powers
blocks.zh: 分数次幂
blocks.label: subsec:analytic-generator-fractional-powers

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Throughout this subsection, we assume that $A$ is the infinitesimal generator of an analytic semigroup and that the spectrum of $A$ lies entirely in the (open) left half-plane. In this case, we shall define fractional powers of $-A$. If the spectrum of $A$ lies in the half-plane $\operatorname{Re}\lambda<\omega$, then we can of course apply the same considerations to define fractional powers of $\omega I-A$. If the spectrum is in the open left half-plane, we can choose a $\delta>0$ such that the spectrum of $A$ is in the half-plane $\operatorname{Re}\lambda<-\delta$, and from the previous subsection we have bounds of the form $\|\exp(At)\|\leq M\exp(-\delta t)$, $\|A\exp(At)\|\leq M_1\exp(-\delta t)/t$. Moreover, by noting that $A^n\exp(At)=(A\exp(A\frac{t}{n}))^n$, we find $\|A^n\exp(At)\|\leq M_n\exp(-\delta t)/t^n$.
blocks.zh: 本小节始终假设 $A$ 为解析半群的无穷小生成元, 且 $A$ 的谱完全位于 (开) 左半平面中. 在这种情形下, 将定义 $-A$ 的分数次幂. 若 $A$ 的谱位于半平面 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda<\omega$ 中, 当然也可用同样的考虑定义 $\omega I-A$ 的分数次幂. 若谱在开左半平面中, 可选取 $\delta>0$, 使 $A$ 的谱位于半平面 $\operatorname{Re}\lambda<-\delta$ 中; 由前一小节, 有如下形式的界 $\|\exp(At)\|\leq M\exp(-\delta t)$, $\|A\exp(At)\|\leq M_1\exp(-\delta t)/t$. 此外, 注意到 $A^n\exp(At)=(A\exp(A\frac{t}{n}))^n$, 得到 $\|A^n\exp(At)\|\leq M_n\exp(-\delta t)/t^n$.

blocks.en: With the obvious convention $(-A)^0=I$, this theorem asserts that the operators $(-A)^{-\alpha}$, $\alpha\geq0$, form a $C_0$-semigroup. It is natural to call the infinitesimal generator $-\log(-A)$, but we shall not pursue this point further.
blocks.zh: 采用显然的约定 $(-A)^0=I$, 这一定理断言算子 $(-A)^{-\alpha}$, $\alpha\geq0$, 构成 $C_0$ 半群. 自然可将无穷小生成元称为 $-\log(-A)$, 但这里不再深入讨论.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
We have\[\begin{aligned}
&(-A)^{-\alpha}(-A)^{-\beta}\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty\int_0^\infty t^{\alpha-1}s^{\beta-1}e^{At}e^{As}\,\mathrm{d}t\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty t^{\alpha-1}\int_t^\infty(u-t)^{\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty\int_0^u t^{\alpha-1}(u-t)^{\beta-1}\,\mathrm{d}t\ e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^1 v^{\alpha-1}(1-v)^{\beta-1}\,\mathrm{d}v\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha+\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha+\beta)}\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha+\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=(-A)^{-\alpha-\beta}.
\end{aligned}\]Since we already know that $\|(-A)^{-\alpha}\|$ is bounded as $\alpha\to0$, it suffices to show that $(-A)^{-\alpha}u\to u$ for $u$ in a dense subset of $X$. Choose $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, then $u=-A^{-1}y$ for some $y\in X$. We then have
\begin{equation}\label{eq:fractional-power-semigroup-strong-continuity-reduction}
(-A)^{-\alpha}u-u=(-A)^{-1-\alpha}y-(-A)^{-1}y,
\end{equation}
and it is clear from either \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-negative-fractional-power-contour} or \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-fractional-power-semigroup-integral} that for $\alpha>0$, $(-A)^{-\alpha}$ is actually continuous (indeed analytic) in the uniform operator topology.
blocks.zh:
有\[\begin{aligned}
&(-A)^{-\alpha}(-A)^{-\beta}\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty\int_0^\infty t^{\alpha-1}s^{\beta-1}e^{At}e^{As}\,\mathrm{d}t\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty t^{\alpha-1}\int_t^\infty(u-t)^{\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\,\mathrm{d}t\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^\infty\int_0^u t^{\alpha-1}(u-t)^{\beta-1}\,\mathrm{d}t\ e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)\Gamma(\beta)}\int_0^1 v^{\alpha-1}(1-v)^{\beta-1}\,\mathrm{d}v\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha+\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha+\beta)}\int_0^\infty u^{\alpha+\beta-1}e^{Au}\,\mathrm{d}u\\
&\quad=(-A)^{-\alpha-\beta}.
\end{aligned}\]由于已经知道 $\|(-A)^{-\alpha}\|$ 在 $\alpha\to0$ 时有界, 只需对 $X$ 的某个稠密子集中的 $u$ 证明 $(-A)^{-\alpha}u\to u$. 选取 $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 则对某个 $y\in X$ 有 $u=-A^{-1}y$. 于是有
\begin{equation}\label{eq:fractional-power-semigroup-strong-continuity-reduction}
(-A)^{-\alpha}u-u=(-A)^{-1-\alpha}y-(-A)^{-1}y,
\end{equation}
由 \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-negative-fractional-power-contour} 或 \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-fractional-power-semigroup-integral} 显然可知, 当 $\alpha>0$ 时, $(-A)^{-\alpha}$ 在一致算子拓扑下实际上连续 (甚至解析).

blocks.en: Since $(-A)^{-n}$ is one-to-one for $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and $(-A)^{-n}=(-A)^{-n+\alpha}(-A)^{-\alpha}$ for $n>\alpha$, it follows that $(-A)^{-\alpha}$ is one-to-one. Hence it has an inverse, which we naturally denote by $(-A)^\alpha$. It is clear that $(-A)^\alpha$ is closed with domain $\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)=\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-\alpha})$; since $\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-n})=\mathcal{D}(A^n)\subset\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-\alpha})$ for $n>\alpha$, it follows that the domain of $(-A)^\alpha$ is dense. Moreover, it is easy to check that $(-A)^{\alpha+\beta}u=(-A)^\alpha(-A)^\beta u$ for any $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ and any $u\in\mathcal{D}((-A)^\gamma)$, where $\gamma=\max(\alpha,\beta,\alpha+\beta)$.\par We conclude this subsection with a result relating $(-A)^\alpha$ to the semigroup.
blocks.zh: 由于 $(-A)^{-n}$ 对 $n\in\mathbb{N}$ 为单射, 且对 $n>\alpha$ 有 $(-A)^{-n}=(-A)^{-n+\alpha}(-A)^{-\alpha}$, 可知 $(-A)^{-\alpha}$ 为单射. 因而它有逆, 自然记为 $(-A)^\alpha$. 显然 $(-A)^\alpha$ 为闭算子, 其定义域为 $\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)=\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-\alpha})$; 由于对 $n>\alpha$ 有 $\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-n})=\mathcal{D}(A^n)\subset\mathcal{R}((-A)^{-\alpha})$, 可知 $(-A)^\alpha$ 的定义域稠密. 此外, 容易验证, 对任意 $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb{R}$ 和任意 $u\in\mathcal{D}((-A)^\gamma)$, 都有 $(-A)^{\alpha+\beta}u=(-A)^\alpha(-A)^\beta u$, 其中 $\gamma=\max(\alpha,\beta,\alpha+\beta)$.\par 以联系 $(-A)^\alpha$ 与半群的一个结果结束本小节.

blocks.en:
If $u\in\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)$, then $u=(-A)^{-\alpha}v$ for some $v$, and we find\[\begin{aligned}
\exp(At)u&=\exp(At)(-A)^{-\alpha}v=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{\alpha-1}\exp(As)\exp(At)v\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&=(-A)^{-\alpha}\exp(At)v=(-A)^{-\alpha}\exp(At)(-A)^\alpha u.
\end{aligned}\]The first claim of the lemma follows by applying $(-A)^\alpha$ to both sides.\par Let $n-1<\alpha<n$, then\[\begin{aligned}
\|(-A)^\alpha\exp(At)\|&=\|(-A)^{\alpha-n}A^n\exp(At)\|\\
&\leq\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{n-\alpha-1}\|A^n\exp(A(t+s))\|\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq\dfrac{M_n}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{n-\alpha-1}(t+s)^{-n}e^{-\delta(t+s)}\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq\dfrac{M_ne^{-\delta t}}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)t^\alpha}\int_0^\infty r^{n-\alpha-1}(1+r)^{-n}\,\mathrm{d}r.
\end{aligned}\]Finally, we have\[\begin{aligned}
\|e^{At}u-u\|&=\left\|\int_0^t Ae^{As}u\,\mathrm{d}s\right\|=\left\|\int_0^t(-A)^{1-\alpha}e^{As}(-A)^\alpha u\,\mathrm{d}s\right\|\\
&\leq C\int_0^t s^{\alpha-1}\|(-A)^\alpha u\|\,\mathrm{d}s\leq C_\alpha t^\alpha\|(-A)^\alpha u\|.
\end{aligned}\]This completes the proof.
blocks.zh:
若 $u\in\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)$, 则对某个 $v$ 有 $u=(-A)^{-\alpha}v$, 从而得到\[\begin{aligned}
\exp(At)u&=\exp(At)(-A)^{-\alpha}v=\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{\alpha-1}\exp(As)\exp(At)v\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&=(-A)^{-\alpha}\exp(At)v=(-A)^{-\alpha}\exp(At)(-A)^\alpha u.
\end{aligned}\]对两端作用 $(-A)^\alpha$, 即得引理的第一个断言.\par 设 $n-1<\alpha<n$, 则\[\begin{aligned}
\|(-A)^\alpha\exp(At)\|&=\|(-A)^{\alpha-n}A^n\exp(At)\|\\
&\leq\dfrac{1}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{n-\alpha-1}\|A^n\exp(A(t+s))\|\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq\dfrac{M_n}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)}\int_0^\infty s^{n-\alpha-1}(t+s)^{-n}e^{-\delta(t+s)}\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq\dfrac{M_ne^{-\delta t}}{\Gamma(n-\alpha)t^\alpha}\int_0^\infty r^{n-\alpha-1}(1+r)^{-n}\,\mathrm{d}r.
\end{aligned}\]最后有\[\begin{aligned}
\|e^{At}u-u\|&=\left\|\int_0^t Ae^{As}u\,\mathrm{d}s\right\|=\left\|\int_0^t(-A)^{1-\alpha}e^{As}(-A)^\alpha u\,\mathrm{d}s\right\|\\
&\leq C\int_0^t s^{\alpha-1}\|(-A)^\alpha u\|\,\mathrm{d}s\leq C_\alpha t^\alpha\|(-A)^\alpha u\|.
\end{aligned}\]证明完成.

blocks.en: Suppose $A$ is the infinitesimal generator of a semigroup. In what sense must $B$ be ``small\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ to be sure that $A+B$ also generates a semigroup? In the context of $C_0$-semigroups, we saw in Problem~\ref{ex:quasicontraction-bounded-operator-perturbation} that it suffices if $B$ is bounded. Indeed, unless conditions other than smallness are imposed, e.g., that both $A$ and $B$ are dissipative, then this is basically the best we can do. In particular, it does not help if $B$ is ``of lower order.\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ The reader may verify that although the operator $Au=u_{xxx}$ generates a $C_0$-semigroup in $L^2(\mathbb{R})$, the operator $(A+B)u=u_{xxx}-u_{xx}$ does not. For analytic semigroups, however, the situation is much better. The main result is the following theorem.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为某半群的无穷小生成元. $B$ 必须在何种意义下 ``小\textquotesingle\textquotesingle, 才能保证 $A+B$ 也生成半群? 对 $C_0$ 半群, 在 Problem~\ref{ex:quasicontraction-bounded-operator-perturbation} 中已看到, $B$ 有界就足够. 实际上, 除非施加小性以外的条件, 例如 $A$ 和 $B$ 均耗散, 这基本上就是所能得到的最佳结果. 特别地, $B$ 为 ``低阶的\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ 并无帮助. 读者可以验证, 虽然算子 $Au=u_{xxx}$ 在 $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ 中生成 $C_0$ 半群, 但算子 $(A+B)u=u_{xxx}-u_{xx}$ 并不生成. 然而, 对解析半群, 情形好得多. 主要结果为以下定理.

blocks.en: Let $A$ be the infinitesimal generator of an analytic semigroup. Then there exists a positive number $\delta$ such that, if $B$ is any operator satisfying\begin{enumerate}\item $B$ is closed and $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}(A)$,\item $\|Bu\|\leq a\|Au\|+b\|u\|$ for $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, where $a<\delta$,\end{enumerate}then $A+B$ is also the infinitesimal generator of an analytic semigroup.
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为解析半群的无穷小生成元. 则存在正数 $\delta$, 使若 $B$ 为满足以下条件的任意算子:\begin{enumerate}\item $B$ 为闭算子, 且 $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}(A)$,\item 对 $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 有 $\|Bu\|\leq a\|Au\|+b\|u\|$, 其中 $a<\delta$,\end{enumerate}则 $A+B$ 也是解析半群的无穷小生成元.
blocks.label: thm:analytic-generator-small-relative-perturbation

blocks.en:
Without loss of generality, we may assume $\omega=0$. If $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)$, then $B(-A)^{-\alpha}$ is bounded; i.e., there is a constant $C$ such that $\|Bu\|\leq C\|(-A)^\alpha u\|$. Hence it suffices to show \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-fractional-lower-order-relative-bound} for $B=(-A)^\alpha$. We have, for $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$,\[\begin{aligned}
\|(-A)^\alpha u\|&\leq\left|\dfrac{\sin(\pi\alpha)}{\pi}\right|\int_0^\rho\lambda^{\alpha-1}\|AR_\lambda(A)\|\|u\|\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&\quad+\left|\dfrac{\sin(\pi\alpha)}{\pi}\right|\int_\rho^\infty\lambda^{\alpha-1}\|R_\lambda(A)\|\|Au\|\,\mathrm{d}\lambda.
\end{aligned}\]We now use the fact that $\|R_\lambda(A)\|\leq M/\lambda$ and $\|AR_\lambda(A)\|\leq1+M$ to complete the proof of the lemma.
blocks.zh:
不失一般性, 可假设 $\omega=0$. 若 $\mathcal{D}(B)\supseteq\mathcal{D}((-A)^\alpha)$, 则 $B(-A)^{-\alpha}$ 有界; 即存在常数 $C$, 使 $\|Bu\|\leq C\|(-A)^\alpha u\|$. 因而只需对 $B=(-A)^\alpha$ 证明 \eqref{eq:analytic-generator-fractional-lower-order-relative-bound}. 对 $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 有\[\begin{aligned}
\|(-A)^\alpha u\|&\leq\left|\dfrac{\sin(\pi\alpha)}{\pi}\right|\int_0^\rho\lambda^{\alpha-1}\|AR_\lambda(A)\|\|u\|\,\mathrm{d}\lambda\\
&\quad+\left|\dfrac{\sin(\pi\alpha)}{\pi}\right|\int_\rho^\infty\lambda^{\alpha-1}\|R_\lambda(A)\|\|Au\|\,\mathrm{d}\lambda.
\end{aligned}\]再利用 $\|R_\lambda(A)\|\leq M/\lambda$ 和 $\|AR_\lambda(A)\|\leq1+M$, 即完成引理的证明.

blocks.en: Let $A$ be the infinitesimal generator of an analytic semigroup and let $u$ be the solution of \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-inhomogeneous-mild-initial-value-problem} as given by \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-mild-solution-representation}. Moreover, let $f\in C^\theta([0,T];X)$. Then:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-away-from-zero} For every $\delta>0$, $Au$ and $\dot u$ are in $C^\theta([\delta,T];X)$.\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-continuity-at-zero} If $u_0\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, then $Au$ and $\dot u$ are in $C([0,T];X)$.\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-zero-compatible-holder} If $u_0=0$ and $f(0)=0$, then $Au$ and $\dot u$ are in $C^\theta([0,T];X)$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: 设 $A$ 为解析半群的无穷小生成元, $u$ 为 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-inhomogeneous-mild-initial-value-problem} 的由 \eqref{eq:analytic-semigroup-mild-solution-representation} 给出的解. 此外, 设 $f\in C^\theta([0,T];X)$. 则:\begin{enumerate}\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-away-from-zero} 对每个 $\delta>0$, $Au$ 和 $\dot u$ 都属于 $C^\theta([\delta,T];X)$.\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-continuity-at-zero} 若 $u_0\in\mathcal{D}(A)$, 则 $Au$ 和 $\dot u$ 都属于 $C([0,T];X)$.\item\label{concl:analytic-mild-regularity-zero-compatible-holder} 若 $u_0=0$ 且 $f(0)=0$, 则 $Au$ 和 $\dot u$ 都属于 $C^\theta([0,T];X)$.\end{enumerate}
